description:
Give tests one way to build a closed `RepositoryImage` from declared entries, listings and pinned evidence, without a storage backend or a mutation session.

## Background

- Pure image construction exists only as private test helpers that each build a synthetic `RepositoryLayout`, a `CaptureSpec` and `RepositoryImage::close` (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/image.rs:708`), for example `layout` and `image_with` in `repository_state/mod.rs:1237,1434`, `image_with` in `repository_state/mutation.rs:1435`, `repository_state/archive.rs:631-645` and `image` in `document/reference.rs:320-350`.
- The helpers it must serve close images over every `RepositoryEntry` kind: files, absences, directories (`repository_state/export.rs`, `archive.rs`, `initialize.rs`, `profile_apply.rs` tests) and symlinks (`export.rs` tests), over listings, over pinned `PinnedDocumentEvidence` keyed by revision and path (`document/reference.rs`, `archive.rs` tests), and some over a capture spec produced by the code under test (`RepositoryExportIntent::capture_spec` in the `export.rs` tests).
- Shared test helpers live in `jit::test_harness` (`crates/jit/src/test_harness.rs`), compiled under `cfg(any(test, feature = "test-support"))` (`crates/jit/src/lib.rs:35-36`), so library unit tests and integration suites both reach it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `jit::test_harness` offers an image builder that takes any `RepositoryEntry` value at a repository-relative or virtual path (files, absences, directories and symlinks), tail-read entries, directory listings and pinned document evidence keyed by revision and path, with either a capture spec derived from what was declared or one the caller supplies, and returns a closed `RepositoryImage` over a fixed synthetic layout or one the caller supplies.
- [hard] REQ-02: Fixture tests show that a file reads back with its bytes, an absence reads as absent, a directory and a symlink read back as declared, a listing reads back with its names, pinned evidence reads back by revision and path, a caller-supplied spec is the image's spec, and a path outside the declared set is refused as uncaptured.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Shared test fixture for repository images
